seller_or_subject: Patreon State of Create report — fan survey data
what: Patreon's "State of Create" report (developed with NewtonX, surveying 2,000 fans) reported that 57% of fans' time on TikTok is spent watching creators they don't follow; 86% of core fans expressed interest in dedicated fan communities; 80% of core fans said they are likely to pay their favorite creators.
verbatim_snippet: (As reported by Tubefilter Feb 19, 2025) "57% of fans' time on TikTok is spent watching creators they don't follow, and most of the content those fans see is short-form in nature — even though longer videos are more desired and more likely to induce payment, according to Patreon's data."
notes: Out of time window. Article dated February 19, 2025, which is before the April 2025 start of the shard window. Data is relevant to buyer behavior but cannot be included in Parts 1–2.
